title: Runtime detekcija sa Falcom
summary: Falco pravila kao kod: liste, makroi, uslovi i outputi, testiranje u replay modu nad .scap snimcima, podešavanje kroz override i izuzetke, izlazi prema Wazuhu i Falcosidekicku i ATT&CK mapiranje kroz tagove.
summary_en: Falco rules as code: lists, macros, conditions and outputs, testing in replay mode against .scap captures, tuning via override and exceptions, outputs to Wazuh and Falcosidekick, and ATT&CK mapping through tags.
